title: A deposit-ledger berth can be superseded by a later verdict
intention: cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py's deposit ledger carries a fourth record kind, 'superseded', naming an owed berth, the later verdict berth that replaces it, and why; pending() stops returning a berth once a superseded record answers it, and the replacing berth must already be enqueued for the same ticket.
why: Akien 2026-10-10, verbatim: "go ahead and cast the b577 repair ticket", following "we need to make the queue record stderr. and the result code for heavens sake. and we preapproved all these things thru PROVED" (idea 2026-10-10-so-you-re-running-builder-is-running). Measured 2026-10-10: berth /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/verdict-20260815T141125-dd35ea1c8f7b.json was written 2026-08-15, commit f8f8ff9d (2026-08-25) made discriminating_observation required on every criterion, the berth was enqueued 2026-09-18, and every drain since refuses it (VerdictRefused, verdicts[0..2]). Once 4818f7f37e1e lands, every `live learn` exits 3 while it stands. Re-depositing it unchanged is impossible, typing the field by hand would record a measurement nobody took, and a new verdict alone leaves the old berth owed forever, because pending() is keyed by berth.
traces_to: Law 7 (the ledger stays append-only and says why an owed berth stopped being owed); Law 8 (a pre-rule verdict leaves the queue only when a re-measured one replaces it, never by being marked deposited).
how: cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py only: add public mark_superseded(berth, *, by, why, ledger_path=None) -> dict beside mark_failed, appending {'kind':'superseded','berth','by','ticket','why','at':_stamp()} through _append. Refuses with ValueError, appending nothing, when: why is empty; berth has no enqueued record; berth already has a deposited or superseded record; by == berth; by has no enqueued record on the ledger; by's enqueued ticket differs from berth's. pending(): landed = berths with kind in ('deposited','superseded'). Charter public_interface names mark_superseded through the artifact door. Depends on 2b34b52f80f3 (mark_failed beside it).

Hollow: not adding 'superseded' to pending's landed set reds 1; dropping any guard reds its case in 2.

decisions.text: A new kind 'superseded', not a reuse of 'deposited': marking the old berth deposited would claim nodes it never became (mark_deposited's own docstring names that lie). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09.
The replacing berth must already be enqueued for the same ticket, so the supersede can never retire an obligation without another one owed in its place. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09.

Edit cairn/tools/chain/verdict_contract.py only: add public mark_superseded(berth, *, by, why, ledger_path=None) -> dict after mark_failed; resolve path as mark_failed does; read_ledger once; refuse with ValueError before any append when why is not a non-empty str, berth has no enqueued record, any deposited or superseded record names berth, by == berth, by has no enqueued record, or by's enqueued ticket differs from berth's; else _append({'kind':'superseded','berth','by','ticket':<berth's enqueued ticket>,'why','at':_stamp()}). pending(): landed = berths whose kind is in ('deposited','superseded'). The ledger header comment names the fourth kind citing this ticket. mark_deposited, mark_failed and enqueue_verdict are not edited. No charter write: the chain charter's public_interface lists the module cairn.tools.chain.verdict_contract, not names (as 2b34b52f80f3 measured for mark_failed). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09.
